title: Join the Movement
coreMove: Turn agreement with the method into one adopted practice that changes how a real team makes uncertain decisions.
sourcePressure: The final chapter widens lean startup from tactic to broader innovation practice and asks readers to apply and spread the discipline concretely.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Ending with inspiration, movement rhetoric, or admiration without operational adoption.

sourceAnchors.name: Join the Movement
sourceAnchors.detail: the sidecar names the closing invitation as applying and spreading the discipline
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Joining the movement starts when one real meeting asks for evidence sooner than it did last week.

sourceAnchors.name: Broader innovation practice
sourceAnchors.detail: the sidecar says the method should travel beyond one company
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The method spreads only when ordinary teams change the way they test uncertain work.

hook: Do not open with a definition of Join the Movement.
Do not use a generic founder staring at a dashboard hook.
Do not start with broad claims about modern business.
counterintuition: Avoid the shell that speed is not the point, learning is the point.
Avoid a simple not X but Y correction if the same rhythm can be replaced by a concrete tension.
Avoid making caution sound like timidity.
tryThisNow: Do not ask the reader to set a timer and reflect.
Do not tell the reader to make a generic list of assumptions.
Do not use a reusable audit-your-work prompt without chapter terms.
examples: No six startup founders in meeting rooms.
No repeated coffee mug, marker, kitchen, classroom, or bus-stop shells.
No invented named case studies, famous companies, studies, or founders.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person 'You' direct address, retrospective 'It took her three weeks to see', question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'

skillTargets: Distinguish Join the Movement from nearby generic advice in a new scenario.

Diagnose when a team is drifting into the misread: Ending with inspiration, movement rhetoric, or admiration without operational adoption.
